# EdgeLink 5400 Series
Enterprise Access Switch

## Product highlights
- 24 or 48 x 1G PoE+ ports with 4 x 10G SFP+ uplinks
- Zero-touch provisioning through the EdgeLink cloud controller
- Layer 3 static routing and RIP

## Technical Specifications

| Model | EL-5424P | EL-5448P |
|---|---|---|
| Ports | 24 x 1G PoE+ | 48 x 1G PoE+ |
| Uplinks | 4 x 10G SFP+ | 4 x 10G SFP+ |
| PoE budget | 370 W | 740 W |
| Switching capacity | 128 Gbps | 176 Gbps |
| Forwarding rate | 95 Mpps | 131 Mpps |

## Physical
Dimensions: 442 x 257 x 44 mm
Weight: 4.1 kg
Operating temperature: 0 to 45 °C

## Management
Web UI, CLI over SSH, SNMP v1/v2c/v3, DHCP option 43 zero-touch.
Default management IP 192.168.1.254

## Ordering information

| Part number | Description |
|---|---|
| EL-5424P-US | 24-port PoE+ switch, US power cord |
| EL-5448P-US | 48-port PoE+ switch, US power cord |
